CH08_items: CH08: Remark 'What is computed' (after cor:c8-homotopy): the sentence identifying D_1 with the Chapter 6 coefficients through eq:c6-step2 and stating that D_1 vanishes on the traceless scalar bilinears is not established; evidence: on the part with two legs A|_Wperp both engines give D_1(O) = 2c O - (1/3 + f) unit {S^(1)(Delta),O}, with c the coefficient of thm:c6-dil (0 traceless, -24 units trace) and f units the coefficient of S^(1)(Delta)|_Wperp in F_1(Delta) (engine B part2.coefficient: factor 1 - (1/3 + b/2) unit, b = 2f; engine A after the symmetrisation of Q(Y1a): 1 + z_2 - 2 = 2/3 - f); f is not fixed by the two-point part of sF_1 = Ob in either engine (compare_delta_b.json part2_scalar_bilinear_component, F_Delta); proposed fix: replace 'Chapter 6 computed the dilatation coefficients through the scaling covariance of the regulator, which give $D_1$ under the identification \eqref{eq:c6-step2}: for the traceless scalar bilinears they vanish, and for the trace bilinear $D_1(O)$ is $-48$ units times $O$, the value $2\times(-24)$ of Theorem \ref{thm:c6-dil}.' by 'Chapter 6 computed the dilatation coefficients through the scaling covariance of the regulator. They give $D_1$ up to a multiple of the classical transformation: on the part of the scalar bilinears with two legs $A|_{W_{\mathbb R}^\perp}$, $D_1(O)$ is twice the coefficient of Theorem \ref{thm:c6-dil} times $O$ ($0$ for the traceless bilinears, $-48$ units times $O$ for the trace) plus $-\big(\tfrac13\text{ units}+\text{the coefficient of }S^{(1)}(\Delta)|_{W_{\mathbb R}^\perp}\text{ in }F_1(\Delta)\big)$ times $\{S^{(1)}(\Delta),O\}$. That coefficient is not fixed by the two-point part of $sF_1=\mathrm{Ob}$; under the hypothesis of Theorem \ref{thm:c8-invariants} (iii) it is fixed by the whole equation, since it changes the spectrum. The identification \eqref{eq:c6-step2} holds exactly when it equals $-\tfrac13$ units; the difference of the eigenvalues of $D_1$ between the trace and the traceless bilinears, $-48$ units, does not depend on it.'

CH08: prop:c8-2pt (iii): the parenthetical identifies the Chapter 6 coefficients used in the scaling identity with the component of def:c8-components along Delta under eq:c6-step2; the scaling identity is an arity-zero statement (it contains no F_1(Delta)) and holds with the Chapter 6 coefficients, while the component differs from them by -(1/3 + f) unit {S^(1)(Delta),-} on the scalar bilinears; evidence: as in the previous item (both engines); in the kernel form of (iii) the extra term drops out because the tree two-point function is classically scale covariant, but in the matrix form (D_1(O_b) = sum_a (D_1)_{ab} O_a on operators at a point) it would add twice the Weyl weight times that multiple to D_1 and a corresponding log(|x|^2/l^2) term that the regulator scaling does not produce, so the matrix in (iii) must be the Chapter 6 one; proposed fix: replace '(the component of Definition \ref{def:c8-components} along $\Delta$ under the identification \eqref{eq:c6-step2})' by '(on the part of the scalar bilinears with two legs $A|_{W_{\mathbb R}^\perp}$ they are the component of Definition \ref{def:c8-components} along $\Delta$ minus its multiple of $\{S^{(1)}(\Delta),-\}$, which is $-\big(\tfrac13\text{ units}+\text{the coefficient of }S^{(1)}(\Delta)|_{W_{\mathbb R}^\perp}\text{ in }F_1(\Delta)\big)$; Remark (What is computed))'.

CH08: def:c8-radial (also thm:c8-adjoint, cor:c8-gram): 'with P_1 = 0 (Proposition prop:c7-cov)' is not a consequence of prop:c7-cov; evidence: on the part of the scalar bilinears with two legs A|_Wperp the composite-line graphs, which exist because (Q^GF)^2 != 0, give P_1(O) = -(1/3 + f_P) unit {S^(1)(P_b),O}, f_P units the coefficient of S^(1)(P_b) in F_1(P_b) (engine B: -1/3 at f_P = 0, closed-form subset 844 = full, complement 0; engine A after symmetrisation: Q(Y1a_T) = -2 D_P O plus (5/3) D_P O from the composite two-point graph; QA y1a_check.json f_translation); the letters, which are not (Q+{I,-})-closed, were not computed; proposed fix: in def:c8-radial replace 'with $P_1=0$ (Proposition \ref{prop:c7-cov})' by 'in a scheme with $P_1=0$ (Proposition \ref{prop:c7-cov} does not give it: on the part of the scalar bilinears with two legs $A|_{W_{\mathbb R}^\perp}$ the graphs with the composite line, which exist because $(Q^{GF})^2\neq0$, give $P_1(O)=-\tfrac13$ units times $\{S^{(1)}(P_n),O\}$ when $F_1(P_n)$ has no component along $S^{(1)}(P_n)$; the finite part of the operators equal to $-\tfrac13$ units times the Weyl weight on the scalar bilinears gives $P_1=0$ there, leaves $D_1$, $M_1$, $R_1$ unchanged and changes the components along $K_b$, $\Sigma$, $\Sigma^*$ by $-\tfrac13$, $+\tfrac16$, $-\tfrac16$ units times the classical transformation, Proposition \ref{prop:c8-laws} (b))'; in thm:c8-adjoint after 'with $P_1=M_1=R_1=0$' add '($P_1=0$ being the scheme condition of Definition \ref{def:c8-radial})'; in cor:c8-gram replace 'With $P_1=0$ the third relation' by 'In the scheme of Definition \ref{def:c8-radial}, with $P_1=0$, the third relation'.

CH08 (via ch07 rem:c7-internal, on which def:c8-radial relies): 'this is the reason these components can be chosen with no one-loop correction for O with (Q+{I,-})O = 0, [(d_CE+Q)O[infty]](x_1) = ({S^(1)(x_1),O})[infty]' fails for translations on the scalar bilinears without a finite part of the operators; evidence: as in the previous item; proposed fix: replace 'this is the reason these components can be chosen with no one-loop correction for $O$ with $(Q+\{I,-\})O=0$,' by 'they nevertheless produce a one-loop part: for the translations on the part of the scalar bilinears with two legs $A|_{W_{\mathbb R}^\perp}$ it is $-\tfrac13$ units times the classical transformation when the finite counterterm has no component along $S^{(1)}(x_1)$; it is removed by the finite part of the operators equal to $-\tfrac13$ units times the Weyl weight on that family (Chapter 8), after which, for $O$ with $(Q+\{I,-\})O=0,$' (the rotations of V admit the same composite line, v.(P*)^2 != 0, and were not computed; along so(W_R^perp) the composite line vanishes).

CH08: prop:c8-Tsafe (proof): 'the two adjacent edges decay as |y|^{-3} each (one derivative, Proposition prop:c3-P)' is false for the A x A component, which carries no derivative and decays as |y|^{-2}; the stated decays (|y|^-6, |y|^-5, |y|^-4) are nevertheless correct because the derivative of the vector field in v.A falls on that edge and the terms of v.A without a derivative of A (dv.A in L_vA, (1/4)(div v)A|_Wperp) have coefficients of one order less; evidence: prop:c8-twocomp (<A_m A_n> = 2(-,-)^{-1} delta_mn (e^{-eps|p|^2} - e^{-T|p|^2})/|p|^2, no momentum factor; <c A*_m> carries -i p_m); for Delta (2y.d_y + 2)|y-a|^{-2} = -2|y|^{-2} + O(|y|^{-3}) times the c x A*|_V edge |y|^{-3} gives |y|^{-5}, odd at leading order; on a cycle only the term (v.A,A*) of S^(1)(x) for even x and (Gamma(epsilon(x),lambda),A*) for odd x have both legs internal (lambda*, c* do not propagate); both engines evaluated the Delta sector directly at T = infinity with finite local results; the theory note's replacement ('of order |y|^{-4} at leading order') is itself wrong for Delta; proposed fix: replace 'and the two adjacent edges decay as $|y|^{-3}$ each (one derivative, Proposition \ref{prop:c3-P})' by 'and each of the two adjacent edges decays as $|y|^{-3}$ once the derivative of the insertion is counted: on a cycle the insertion is $(v.A,A^*)$ for even and $(\Gamma(\epsilon(x),\lambda),A^*)$ for odd generators, the components $c\otimes A^*|_V$ and $\lambda\otimes\lambda$ of $P(\varepsilon,T)$ carry one derivative (Proposition \ref{prop:c3-P}), and the component $A\otimes A$, which decays as $|y|^{-2}$, is the edge on which the derivative in $L_vA$ acts, the terms of $v.A$ without a derivative of $A$ having coefficients of one order less in $|y|$'.
open_issues: Letters: engine B's statement that the letters have no composite graphs concerns only the special-edge cycles through O (K5); the letters are not (Q+{I,-})-closed, so in the UV-boundary form the vertex {I,O} != 0 carries composite loops, and in the direct route of engine A the composite two-point graph on the leg gives {class (i)_T, O} = (5/3) D_P O; the translation (and dilatation) components of the letters are therefore not established, and neither is the theory's "c = 0 for the letters" (prop:d-P (ii)) nor B's "no single F(P) removes it for letters and bilinears".

The coefficient of S^(1)(Delta)|_Wperp in F_1(Delta) (engine A f_S, engine B b/2) is undetermined; it sets the classical normalisation 1 - (1/3 + f) unit of the Delta component and the absolute one-loop eigenvalue -4(1/3 + f) units of the traceless bilinears. The theory assigns it to the cubic arity-one equation and the full S^(1)(Delta) coefficient z to the arity-two equation along (K_b,P_b'); protection of the traceless bilinears (arity two along (xi,eta) with R_1 = 0) predicts f = -1/3 units. Not computed.
Same for the coefficient of S^(1)(P_b) in F_1(P_b) (fixed at arity two along (xi,xi') through [Sigma,Sigma] containing P); not computed.

Rotations of V: the composite line v.(P*)^2 is nonzero for so(V) (it vanishes for so(W_R^perp)); M_1 on the scalar bilinears (orbital part on integrated operators) was not computed, so the assumption M_1 = 0 of prop:c8-primary and thm:c8-adjoint is untested.

Only the bilinear (A|_Wperp, A|_Wperp) output of the scalar-bilinear component was computed by either engine; the (A_V,A_V) and (c,A*_V) outputs of the trace bilinear, all letters, the cubic arity-one equation and the arity-two equations are open.
